levels.title: First Pickup
levels.briefing: Tap a guard to approach and attack with your knife. Use the branching warehouse walls to flank, collect the Seeker and escape along the outer lane.

levels.title: Blind Corner
levels.briefing: Use the staggered crates to break sight. The drone reports your position; flank it before crossing the upper yard. Recover the Seeker and return to the service entrance.

levels.title: Crossfire
levels.briefing: Cross a laser and its alarm flashes for 1.5 seconds. Nearby guards investigate that crossing once. Move behind cover before they arrive; a real sighting starts a full chase.

levels.title: Loading Lockdown
levels.briefing: Use the staggered cover and central pillars to flank. Side-lane lasers briefly alert nearby guards. Taking the Seeker calls a reinforcement—plan the return to the bottom entrance.

levels.title: Skybridge
levels.briefing: The twin walls create a narrow center approach and longer crate-lined flanks. The left laser alerts nearby guards once. Recover the Seeker, then circle the large lower block to the entrance.

levels.title: Heavy Watch
levels.briefing: Circle the lower U-barrier, then weave between the cargo islands. Flank the Heavy’s mint rear panel. The upper gallery has offset openings—recover the Seeker and return to the bottom entrance.

levels.title: Split Route
levels.briefing: Enter through either lower gap. Cross the long central laser for a shorter route, or flank around the cross-walls using outer cover. Lasers alert nearby guards once; relocate before they arrive. Recover the Seeker in the upper-left pocket and return to the entrance.

levels.title: Twin Relay
levels.briefing: Recover the phone inside the central room, then the phone beyond the upper wall. Both side openings give flanking routes. The courtyard laser briefly alerts nearby guards; the first pickup brings one reinforcement. Return each phone to the bottom entrance.

levels.title: Dark Circuit
levels.briefing: Weave around the cargo islands and activate the central switch to open the upper vault. Side galleries help you flank patrols. The striped shortcut makes noise. Recover the Seeker beyond the gate, then return to the bottom entrance.

levels.title: Vault Window
levels.briefing: Reach the shelter beside extraction, then cross when its mint lights open. The pickup response will pursue you.

levels.title: Security Grid
levels.briefing: Break contact between rooms. Nearby enemies join a confirmed chase. They search your last sighting for five seconds before returning to patrol.

levels.title: Last Seeker
levels.briefing: Flank the Warden, interrupt the drone and plan your escape. Taking the last Seeker calls both marked entrances.
